artists.biography: Public Image Ltd. (PiL) are an English musical group formed in 1978 by vocalist John Lydon, guitarist Keith Levene, and bassist Jah Wobble. Rising from the ashes of the pivotal punk rock group the Sex Pistols, PiL branched out to a more experimental sound, and their early work is often regarded as some of the most challenging and innovative music of the post-punk era: the NME[1] described PiL as "Arguably the first post-rock group". Their later music would be somewhat more conventional, and although PiL has been inactive since 1992, Lydon (the band's only constant member) considers the group "on hiatus" rather than broken up. perplexity.description:
The Greatest Hits, So Far is a compilation album by English post-punk pioneers Public Image Ltd, released in October 1990 on Virgin Records. The collection surveys the band's output from their formation in 1978 through 1990, capturing the evolution of their distinctive blend of post-punk and electronic experimentation. The album includes the new track "Don't Ask Me," offering listeners both a retrospective of the band's most significant work and fresh material from the period.

As a greatest hits compilation, the album documents Public Image Ltd's influential trajectory through the post-punk and industrial music landscape of the 1980s. The band's sonic approach—characterized by angular guitars, synthesizers, and John Lydon's distinctive vocal delivery—defined much of the era's avant-garde rock aesthetic. By 1990, the compilation served as a comprehensive overview of their artistic achievements across their most commercially and critically significant recordings.

The release functioned as both a career retrospective and a marker of the band's enduring legacy within post-punk and electronic music. While specific critical reception details are limited, the compilation's existence on major formats including CD, vinyl, and cassette indicates substantial commercial interest in the band's catalog during this period. The album remains a standard entry point for listeners exploring Public Image Ltd's influential body of work.
